title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.5 Other Strategies for Integration: Use a table of integrals to solve integration problems.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, 3.5 Other Strategies for Integration: Use a table of integrals to solve integration problems.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2, section "3.5 Other Strategies for Integration", prints these objectives: "Use a table of integrals to solve integration problems." "Use a computer algebra system (CAS) to solve integration problems.". The section text says: "In addition to the techniques of integration we have already seen, several other tools are widely available to assist with the process of integration. Among these tools are integration tables , which are readily available in many books, including the appendices to this one. Also widely available are computer algebra systems (CAS) , which are found on calculators and in many campus computer labs, and are free online." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
